annotations.title: List form entries for a site

description: Lists the entries visitors sent through a site's built-in forms, newest first: the submitted fields, whether the notification email was sent, and when. Optional form_key narrows it to one form. limit defaults to 50 (max 200). No visitor IP data is returned. Test entries sent from a staged preview are left out unless include_preview is true. Entries whose notification email could not be delivered are marked 'Not emailed' and are still listed here. Free.

form_key.description: Optional: only entries from this form.

include_preview.description: Also list test entries sent from a staged preview (they are marked as preview entries). Default false.

limit.description: How many entries, newest first. Default 50, max 200.

site_key.description: The site whose form entries to list. Must be yours.

name: list_form_submissions
title: List form entries for a site
